channel.name: BSP 4K Status
channel.description: Creating viral emotional & romantic content that connects millions of hearts across India.

timeline.title: Channel Born 🚀
timeline.description: Started BSP 4K Status — uploading emotional & romantic short-form content.

timeline.title: First 1K Subscribers 🎯
timeline.description: Hit the first major milestone. The grind was real, but the community was growing.

timeline.title: First Viral Short 💥
timeline.description: A romantic emotional video exploded — crossing 700K+ views in days.

timeline.title: The Dip 📉
timeline.description: Views dropped to 400 avg per video. Algorithm shifted. Had to rethink strategy.

timeline.title: Strategy Shift 🧠
timeline.description: Switched to trend-based emotional hooks. Focused on first 2-second hook and mobile-first content.

timeline.title: 25K Subscribers 🎉
timeline.description: Consistent posting + emotional storytelling = steady growth. Community becoming loyal.

timeline.title: Mega Viral Month 🔥
timeline.description: 1.8M views in a single month! Multiple shorts went viral simultaneously.

timeline.title: 50K+ Subscribers 👑
timeline.description: Crossed 50K subs. Monetization active. Revenue growing month over month.

timeline.title: 99M+ Views & Counting 📈
timeline.description: 62.5K subscribers, 99.4M total views, 322K watch hours. The journey continues!

strategy.title: Hook in 2 Seconds
strategy.description: First 2 seconds decide everything. Every video opens with an emotional or curiosity hook.

strategy.title: Emotional Storytelling
strategy.description: Love, heartbreak, relationships — content that makes viewers FEEL something deeply.

strategy.title: Mobile-First Content
strategy.description: 9:16 vertical format optimized for Shorts. Every frame designed for phone screens.

strategy.title: Trend Surfing
strategy.description: Riding trending audio, hashtags (#instagram #reels #trending) for maximum discovery.

strategy.title: Consistent Posting
strategy.description: Multiple uploads per week. Algorithm rewards consistency over sporadic viral hits.

strategy.title: Community Building
strategy.description: Engaging with every comment. Building loyal fans who share and come back for more.

worked.title: Trend-based audio + hashtags
worked.result: Videos appear in Shorts feed 5x more
